article.headline: Boston takes road win streak into matchup with Toronto
article.description: Boston Celtics (9-2, first in the Eastern Conference) vs. Toronto Raptors (5-5, sixth in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Boston takes road win streak into matchup with Toronto
article.linkText: Boston takes road win streak into matchup with Toronto
article.story: Boston Celtics (9-2, first in the Eastern Conference) vs. Toronto Raptors (5-5, sixth in the Eastern Conference) Toronto; Wednesday, 7 p.m. EST LINE: Celtics -6.5; over/under is 215.5 BOTTOM LINE: Boston will try to keep its three-game road win streak alive when the Celtics play Toronto. Toronto went 46-36 overall, 33-19 in Eastern Conference games and 24-17 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Raptors averaged 114.6 points per game last season, 18.0 on free throws and 34.2 from deep. Boston went 56-26 overall and 10-6 in Atlantic Division action during the 2025-26 season. The Celtics gave up 107.2 points per game while committing 19.0 fouls last season. INJURIES: Raptors: Kawhi Leonard: out (knee), Nate Bittle: out (foot), Collin Murray-Boyles: day to day (illness), Scottie Barnes: out (adductor), Trayce Jackson-Davis: day to day (illness), Immanuel Quickley: day to day (hamstring). Celtics: Devin Carter: out (illness). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
